page.overview:
Who is Forte?

The Female Saiyan Berserker is a playable Saiyan avatar in Dragon Ball Heroes.

The Female Berserker is of average height with light brown skin, black onyx eyes, and black spiky hair kept in a ponytail with a yellow hair tie. She wears black and brass yellow Battle Armor that resembles the model that Vegeta typically wears with a sleeveless, short-legged purple jumpsuit, bicep-length black fingerless gloves, black boots and a yellow thigh-high legging worn on her left leg.

Her second Class-up outfit consists of a similar model of armor with shoulder and hip guards, plus a small V-shaped opening just above her chest. She wears armored black fingerless gloves similar to the ones worn by Raditz and Nappa, along with yellow leggings and black boots with large shin guards.

Her third Super Class-up outfit is significantly different, consisting of a black and dark gray armored jumpsuit with brass yellow guards on the shoulders and sides of her legs. She also wears black boots with brass yellow tips and ropes around the ankles.
